title: 150th-day anti-government demonstration and march in Sofia
location: Sofia, Council of Ministers, central streets and Orlov Most
threshold_50_evidence: The body confirms a physical rally, march and blockades but provides no crowd count; “day 150” refers to elapsed campaign time, not turnout.

start_date.summary: Both opened accounts describe the physical rally on 5 December; Bgonair says it began at 14:00.

location.summary: Bgonair places start outside Council of Ministers and describes central march/blockades; Debati reports Dondukov Boulevard blocked.

demands.summary: Participants demanded resignation of the government and chief prosecutor.

participants.summary: Neither opened passage reports attendance; the 150-day campaign marker is not a crowd estimate.

threshold_50.summary: No size estimate establishes 50 simultaneous participants.

protester_violence.summary: Reports say rotten pumpkins/apples were thrown at the government building; coded as protester violence against a government site.

state_response.summary: No supported state-response action is established by the read passages; unknown, not inferred from silence.

notes: This is a date-specific December 5 assembly within a campaign reported to have started on 9 July. It is not coded as every day of that campaign. January searches found later physical rallies, but no uninterrupted continuity/end date is inferred. Rotten produce was thrown at the Council of Ministers; no injury/property damage is inferred.
open_questions: Is the 5 December rally a distinct action or a continuation of earlier rallies?

title: National taxi-driver protest in Sofia and announced municipal sites
location: Sofia (actual procession/rally documented); other municipalities announced but not verified
organizer: Federation of Taxi Drivers and Carriers (named in advance report; NOVA notes not all companies supported action).
participants_original: About ten yellow cars at the Sofia location; no person count; nationwide participant total unknown.
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous 50-person count. The main opened report confirms physical action; OFFNews describes about ten cars in Sofia, and no other-city participant counts were found in this bounded search.

start_date.summary: NOVA and OFFNews document taxi protest activity on 15 December.

location.summary: NOVA says drivers marched in central Sofia from three starting points to Alexander Nevsky; OFFNews reports about ten yellow cars there. National scope was announced but execution elsewhere is unverified.

demands.summary: Drivers sought higher minimum fares, removal of the 2021 patent tax, and related transport rules directed to the city and national ministries.

organizer.summary: Bgonair identifies the Federation of Taxi Drivers and Carriers as organizer in its advance report.

participants.summary: OFFNews reports about ten yellow vehicles in Sofia; this is a vehicle count, not a count of people. No turnout figures from other municipalities are verified.

threshold_50.summary: The actual Sofia event is established but its people count is absent; the low observed vehicle presence does not establish 50 people. Other-city turnout is unknown and cannot be pooled without evidence.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence reported in the read passages; unknown.

notes: The 15 December march is a new physical date-specific rally. Related late-November transport/taxi actions are recorded in November and were concluded as a two-day sequence; similarity in organizer/issue alone does not prove uninterrupted continuation. A municipal notice (S011) found by search was actually a 2024 notice and is excluded.
open_questions: Were 50 or more people present at one simultaneous national action across municipalities?
Were other municipal gatherings executed and what were their counts?
Is this a renewed event in the November tariff campaign or a separate episode?
